content: We need to return mapped_rxn and template_id for the template that when applied to the given molecule reproduces the HWE reaction (retro step). We have precursors from previous task: three possible precursors (list of lists). Those are likely the product of applying a template to the target molecule. The template ID we need to find. We need to search template catalog for a template that matches the transformation: carbon-phosphorus bond broken, carbon-oxygen broken, carbon-carbon double bond formed, aliphatic carboxylic acid formed. The forward reaction: aldehyde/ketone + phosphonate carbanion -> alkene + phosphonate byproduct? Actually HWE: phosphonate + aldehyde -> alkene + phosphate (byproduct). In retrosynthesis, we break alkene to aldehyde and phosphonate. So template likely breaks C=C and forms C=O and C-P? But description says carbon-carbon bond formed, carbon-phosphorus bond and carbon-oxygen are broken. So forward: C-P and C-O broken, C=C formed. So retro: C=C broken, C-P formed, C-O formed. So functional groups formed in forward: aliphatic carboxylic acid and C-C double bonds. In retro, we need to form phosphonate and carbonyl? The template likely has functional groups broken: C-C double bonds, aliphatic carboxylic acid? Actually forward forms those, so broken in forward are C-P and C-O. So we can search with functional_groups_broken = ["C-P", "C-O"]? Not in list. Use bonds broken maybe. But we need template ID. Could try to get available functional groups list to see appropriate names.
